He unlocked his ex-girlfriend's phone while she slept. With her finger, and her eyelids.
Nanning, December twenty twenty. Huang, twenty-eight, has debts, including gambling debts.
He visits his ex. He says he's come to pay back money he borrowed.
He presses her finger to her phone. It unlocks.
Then the payment app asks for a face scan. Her eyes are closed.
It works. He moves about one hundred and fifty-four thousand yuan to himself: her savings, and money borrowed on her credit.
He takes her phone and a coat, and leaves.
The next morning, she sees the transfers on her other phone.
Months later, police arrest him in another city.
The court gives him three and a half years, plus a twenty thousand yuan fine.
Is your face enough to protect your money?
